title: Briefing Senate Intelligence Committee investigators unaware of facilities

tellings.quote: Now when I was briefing the senior investigators for Senate Intelligence Committee when I first started meeting with them, they didn't know we had these facilities.

plain: A man named Steven Greer says that when he first started meeting with senior investigators for the Senate Intelligence Committee, the Senate committee that oversees the US spy agencies, they did not know that certain secret facilities existed. Greer says he briefed them in person. He tells it on the show to suggest that UFO secrets are kept even from the officials who are meant to oversee them.
